VideoCallInsightAction.name: VideoCallInsightAction
VideoCallInsightAction.description: Represents a suggested follow-up action derived from a video call insight. VideoCallInsightAction manages recommended steps—such as sending an email, creating a task, or scheduling a meeting—that address specific moments, including competitor mentions, pricing discussions, or objections.

ActionCategory.description: The category that classifies the purpose of the action.

ActionReferenceId.description: Required. ID of the reference record associated with the generated action.

ActionType.description: The specific type of action to be performed for the insight.

CompletionDateTime.description: Required. The timestamp when the action was completed.

Name.description: The name of the insight action.

Status.description: The status of the insight action.

VideoCallInsightId.description: Required. ID of the VideoCallInsight record associated with a video call. Each record represents the call insight of a specific recording or transcript within a call.

VideoCallInsightAction.accessRules: the Conversation Insights for Sales permission set
